title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Transport options Our service boasts a diverse range of transportation options, including standard vehicles and those specially modified for mobility needs. This variety ensures we can cater to the unique requirements of each client, providing accessible and comfortable travel solutions for accessing disability supports and fulfilling personal goals. Our commitment is to ensure reliable, tailored transport services for every client’s convenience and independence. Our fleet options Our fleet At Embrace Healthcare Solutions, we warmly welcome our clients with a range of transportation options to meet every need. Our fleet includes both standard vehicles for ease of travel and specially equipped mobility vehicles, such as the Toyota Hiace, Toyota Voxy, and Toyota Alphard, designed for comfort and accessibility. All our vehicles are GPS tracked and are equipped with Driver Behaviour Monitoring System and Dash Cams to provide extra level of safety for our clients.
